planScope: D0 release verification and bounded request attempts
problem: The public snapshot checker retried an HTTP 403 security checkpoint thirty times at a fixed three-second interval.
changes: Stop immediately on HTTP 401, 403, 407 or a recognized security checkpoint, including a checkpoint returned with HTTP 200.
Respect Retry-After seconds and HTTP dates; back off transient transport failures and defer when the required delay exceeds the run budget.
Keep cache-busted complete snapshots, exact release, immutable asset, manifest, Firebase configuration and Auth checks.
Bound request and snapshot duration and report structured failures without copying challenge bodies.
